steps: Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and the last cleanups.
Keep the save plan from Stage 1: a manual save at the start and end of every chapter, so a missed step never costs a replay.
Do the one thing that can actually go wrong early: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude).
When the last trophy before this one pops, the platinum follows immediately — no need to visit any menu.
guide.summary: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — no multiplayer, no DLC and no extra task of its own. Everything in this guide exists to get you here.
tips: PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours; Push Square says 250+ hours. The bulk is the 100% checklist, not the story.
On Xbox the same achievement is the Mythic achievement and is worth 0 Gamerscore — all 1,000 points come from the other 54.
guide.tracking: Automatic — the trophy list itself is the tracker. This guide's header shows your live count out of 55.

steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, as Jason.
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission — it is a short introduction to driving, the phone and the open world.
The trophy pops as the mission completes and the open world opens up.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission of the game, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. You cannot miss it and there is nothing to prepare.
tips: Use this first stretch to learn the WAiNK phone app: hold Up to scan vehicles you pass. Every scan counts toward Whip It Good and the 100% checklist.
Do not turn cheats on at any point — cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops at the end of Gone Fishing.

steps: Play through Chapter 1's main missions in order; there are no branching paths that affect trophies.
Before the chapter ends, do the one time-sensitive thing in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Start Chapter 2 and finish its first main mission, What's in the Bag?, and the trophy pops.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It actually pops a little late: PowerPyx notes it lands once you clear the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
tips: Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 and another at its end. With no mission replay, chapter saves are your only safety net.
Kenton's treasure-diving strand opens in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams — take it when it appears; it stays available later, but starting early spreads the work out.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops early in Chapter 2.

steps: Play Chapter 2 through to its end. This is the chapter where the game opens up: after Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together.
Use Chapter 2 to start the systems that pay off later: the Scooter Bros app and the Vice City Real Estate app both arrive here, and so do the first meditation spots you can do with both characters.
Begin Chapter 3, finish Welcome to Vice City, and the trophy pops.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops slightly late, once you clear the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
tips: Coffee Break is the single most important unlock in the game: partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best, the paired meditations) all need it.
Billy's strand opens at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break, and Moses' garage app arrives after Daily Driver — take both when they appear.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops early in Chapter 3.

steps: Play Chapter 3 through. This is the busiest chapter for trophy unlocks: the Key Cloner, the Snap Gun and Yasmani's jewelry jobs all arrive here.
Finish Randy's Zorrusso delivery (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS) to unlock the Key Cloner — it is required for Capital Offense and for Randy's whole wish list.
Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies — required for Sneakthief.
Start Chapter 4, clear Ocean Beach and Another Life, and the trophy pops.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It pops once you clear the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
tips: Andy's strand (Lucia only) opens in Chapter 3 with a phone call; Tyrone's labs open after Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason only). Both stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but starting them now spreads the work out.
Scan every sports car you see with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1). Randy wants 16 of them and the app tells you on the spot whether a car is on his list.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops early in Chapter 4.

steps: Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission, Starting From Zero.

Chapter 4 is where the big robbery systems open: the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… introduces bank vault robberies, which unlock Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together.
Finish Starting From Zero and the trophy pops with the chapter.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It pops once you complete the final main mission of the chapter, Starting From Zero.
tips: Do the bank-vault introduction mission the moment it is marked — every large bank job after it pays up to $205,000 and counts toward Dime on the Dollar.
Keep a manual save before the final mission. It is good practice with no mission replay, and the endgame cleanup starts right after.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops at the end of Starting From Zero.

steps: Play Chapter 5 through to the final mission.
Finish the final mission. The trophy pops as the story closes.
After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy — the gold for finishing the game. Complete the final mission in Chapter 5 and it pops. Nothing before it can lock you out: free-roam continues after the credits and everything needed for the platinum is still available.
tips: Make a manual save right before the final mission, then another right after. Those two saves bracket the whole endgame.
Do not worry about anything you have not finished yet: PowerPyx confirms nothing toward 100% is missable and everything is doable in free-roam.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops at the end of the final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps: Reach Chapter 2 and play the main missions in order until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete Breakfast Run. The trophy pops during the mission.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. There is no preparation and no way to miss it — just play the story.
tips: Breakfast Run is one of the six main-mission trophies (one in Chapter 2, one in Chapter 3, three in Chapter 4, one in Chapter 5). They all pop by playing the story.
If you are tracking the story set, this is the first of the six — the other five are Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked and Snow Storm.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops during Breakfast Run.

steps: Reach Chapter 3 and play the main missions in order until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete The Cartel Heist. The trophy pops during the mission.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story and it pops on its own.
tips: Heist missions are good practice for the robbery trophies later: the same ideas — bring your partner, carry the bags, escape the heat — come back in Maximum Withdrawal.
Nothing in this mission affects any other trophy, so play it however you like.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops during The Cartel Heist.

steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main missions in order until Child's Play appears.
Complete Child's Play. The trophy pops during the mission.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Play the story and it pops on its own.
tips: Chapter 4 holds three of the six main-mission trophies: Child's Play, Headliners (DWNFALL) and VCIA Takedown (Hi-Jacked). All three pop by playing the story.
This is also the chapter where the bank-vault optional mission appears — take it when it is marked, it opens the best money in the game.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops during Child's Play.

steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main missions in order until Headliners appears.
Complete Headliners. The trophy pops during the mission.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Play the story and it pops on its own.
tips: Headliners is the second of Chapter 4's three main-mission trophies, between Child's Play and VCIA Takedown.
No preparation is needed. If you are doing the story straight through, this is one of the trophies you will barely notice popping.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops during Headliners.

steps: Reach Chapter 4 and play the main missions in order until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete VCIA Takedown. The trophy pops during the mission.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Play the story and it pops on its own.
tips: VCIA is also where Catch Me If You Can happens — stealing a docked passenger jet from the airport. You can do that trophy in free-roam after the story; the mission itself does not require it.
This is the last of Chapter 4's three main-mission trophies.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops during VCIA Takedown.

steps: Reach Chapter 5 and play the main missions in order until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops during the mission.
guide.summary: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story and it pops on its own.
tips: This is the last of the six main-mission trophies — the set is Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked and Snow Storm.
After this mission the final mission is close. Keep the chapter-save habit: one save before it, one after.
guide.tracking: Automatic — pops during Operation Savage Glory.

steps: Finish the story. The checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; everything you did during the story already counts.
Work the checklist in this order: optional missions first (any 100 of 200–300+), then vehicles (scan any 200 of 277 base models with WAiNK) and animals (study any 100 of 255 through the binoculars).
Do the all-or-nothing rows: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's Target Decks.
Finish the partial rows: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets.
When the last row ticks over, the gold pops. The checklist is closer to 60% true completion — it is lenient by design.
guide.summary: The hardest trophy in the set, and the whole reason the roadmap exists. The 100% checklist is not true 100%: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of everything in the game, with most side quests not required at all and most collectible types only partly required. The only rows that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
tips: Do optional missions as they appear during the story — you need any 100, and there are 200–300+ in the game, so you will pass 100 without trying if you take them.
Each meditation spot counts as +2 if you do it with both Jason and Lucia together. For 100% you only need 15 of 18 meditations.
Scan boats and aircraft too, not just cars — every base model counts toward the 200. Every breed of dog and cat counts separately toward the 100 animals.
guide.tracking: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (unlocks after the story). The checklist itself is the tracker.

steps: Find stunt spots on the map: Map > Exploration (magnifying glass) > Stunt Spots. Every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once completed.

Pick the easiest category first. Under the Bridges (202) are the quickest — fly under a bridge and it counts. Stunt Jumps (130) are ramps, Knife Flights (40) are gaps between buildings, Base Jumps (25) are parachute challenges.
Mix categories freely; the trophy counts any 250 of the 397 stunts. You only need to perform each stunt once — the optional challenges on the map icons are not required.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts (press R3 on a category), or watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list.
guide.summary: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds — 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — and you can mix them however you like. For the 100% checklist you need 300, so this trophy comes on the way to A Long Road.
tips: Under the Bridges is the fastest route to 250: a plane or helicopter through a bridge gap counts instantly, and there are 202 of them.
Stunts you complete during the story already count. If you fly everywhere instead of driving, you will clear dozens without trying.
guide.tracking: Progress > Activities > Stunts, or Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.

steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities. The tracker counts 9 activity types and shows how many of each you have done.
Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt.
Most of these are introduced by the story or marked when you unfog the map. Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find them.
guide.summary: Try each of the 9 activity types once. You will do most of them automatically while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so this is a trophy you should not chase — just check the tracker and mop up whichever type is still at zero.
tips: The quickest to force: a video game at the TV at home (Stick Fiddler), one fishing trip with Cal, and one stunt jump.
Golf and pool are the two people most often miss — both are marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map once the area is unfogged.
guide.tracking: Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scroll over each type to see your count.

trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps: Find the 12 shooting range locations. The challenges are listed per range; there are 42 gold medals to earn in total.
Work one range at a time. Gold is about accuracy and speed together — take the first shot slowly, then keep a rhythm instead of rushing and missing.
Use the range's own recommended weapon where one is given. A steady aim beats a fast trigger finger; the timer is generous if you do not miss.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which you need for Gunslinger, so this trophy feeds directly into another.
guide.summary: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The ranges are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so there is no way around them — but gold is very achievable: PowerPyx calls the range golds not too difficult.
tips: If a challenge feels impossible, leave it and come back after raising Focus at the ranges — Focus level 4 makes the later challenges noticeably easier.
You only need 70 of 80 challenges for 100%, but this trophy needs all 42 range golds, so do not skip the hard ones here.
guide.tracking: At each range, or Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations. There are 42 drone races in total across them.
Win at least one race at each of the 14 locations. You do not need to win all 42 — one win per location is enough.
Drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so the remaining races are worth doing while you are there anyway.
Learn each course once before racing it for real: a slow practice lap beats three crashed attempts.
guide.summary: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in the game, but the trophy only needs one win per location — the rest is 100% checklist work.
tips: Races count toward Master of None too (win a race challenge), so a drone race win can tick two trophies at once.
If a course keeps beating you, switch to a different location and come back later — the trophy only cares that each location has one win.
guide.tracking: At each location, or Progress > Activities > Top Fun Drone Races.

trophies.name: Top Fun

steps: Open the race list: there are 40 unique race locations in Leonida.
Win 20 different races — repeats do not count, so each win has to be at a new location.
Mix race types freely: car races, bike races and drone races all count toward the 20.
Use the fastest vehicle you own for each race. Street races are easier in a car you have tuned; drone races reward a steady hand more than speed.
guide.summary: Win 20 different races across Leonida's 40 unique race locations. Repeats at the same location do not count, so you need breadth, not grinding one easy race.
tips: Top Fun drone race wins count here too, so the 14 drone locations can cover most of the 20 if you enjoy flying.
Race locations are marked on the map once the area is unfogged. Work through them region by region instead of criss-crossing the state.
guide.tracking: Progress > Activities > Races — the list shows which locations you have won.

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps: Play Chapter 1 until the main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal.
After that, Cal sends a text message that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map.
Follow Cal's fishing questline. Fish where he tells you, and beat him in the fishing challenge when it comes up.
Fishing also raises your Focus level and counts toward Master of None, so it is worth doing properly rather than rushing.
guide.summary: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal appears in Chapter 1 (Feng Shui), then texts you a fishing spot. Follow his short questline and the challenge — and the trophy — follows.
tips: If Cal's text has not arrived yet, keep playing the story: his strand opens in sequence, not on a timer you can force.
Fishing challenges are about timing the reel, not strength. Watch the line tension and reel in short bursts.
guide.tracking: Cal's questline is marked with purple icons; the challenge itself is the tracker.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV at home — interact with the controllers. You can do this from Chapter 1.
Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world.
Pick whichever game you like best and finish all of its levels at least once. You do not need to beat every challenge inside it, just reach the end.
guide.summary: Complete any one arcade game. Three of the four games are on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and the fourth is on arcade machines around Leonida. Finishing all levels of one game once is enough — no high score needed.
tips: Tenebrae Lux is usually the quickest to finish if you just want the trophy. Play whichever one you enjoy; the trophy does not care which.
The TV games are sometimes unavailable during story sections, but they are always available again after the story.
guide.tracking: In-game — the game ends and the trophy pops. Also counts toward Master of None (playing a video game).

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3. Andy's strand is Lucia-only: at some point you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address in Belville and the strand is marked.

Complete Andy's 5 quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse).
Finish Puff Puff Pass and the trophy pops. All of Andy's quests are still available after the story.
guide.summary: Finish Andy's 5-quest strand. It opens in Chapter 3 for Lucia only, with a phone call and then a text giving her Belville address. The strand is a Cellerica cult-comedy chain — climb it, pay the fee, join the initiation, fetch the van and meet at the warehouse.
tips: If you mostly play as Jason, remember to switch to Lucia in Chapter 3 or Andy's call never comes.
Andy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — it is a separate questline trophy. Do not confuse the two counters.
guide.tracking: Progress > Characters > Andy (or the quest markers on the map).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps: In Chapter 1, after the main mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), Kenton calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento.
Kenton marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — shipwrecks. Dive to them, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back to him.
After the first set he calls you back to his shop, then marks more locations. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total for his strand.
After Chapter 1 Kenton goes quiet for a while. He comes back in Chapters 2–3 — as Jason, call Brian and Kenton texts you shortly after. His strand is not missable.
guide.summary: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving strand: 7 shipwrecks in total. It opens in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams and is marked with a green KR in Key Lento. Dive, detect, dig up the treasure and bring it back — then do it again when he marks the next set.
tips: Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees, and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
If Kenton has gone quiet, do not panic: he returns in Chapters 2–3. Calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return up.
guide.tracking: Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees; Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps: Play Chapter 2 until the main mission Coffee Break. After it, Billy's strand is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

Complete Billy's 5 quests in order: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (join Billy on a job), Mall Rats (join Billy on a job), The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes (join Billy on a job).
Finish Hometown Heroes and the trophy pops. All of Billy's quests are still available after the story.
guide.summary: Finish Billy's 5-quest strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 and runs through mud-club jobs, a mall job and stealing the Impaler.
tips: Billy's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — it is a separate questline trophy.
The Impaler is the one people remember: steal the car, do not just borrow it. The quest text tells you which one.
guide.tracking: Quest markers at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps: Find strangers in the open world. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count as strangers for this trophy.

These strands are confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries).
Complete any 8 of these stranger strands. More strangers are still being discovered, so check the Sources page for the latest confirmed list.
All stranger strands are still available after the story in free-roam.
guide.summary: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. The catch is that only some questlines count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not strangers for this trophy. Pick 8 confirmed strands and finish them.
tips: Check the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many strands you have completed — it is the only in-game counter.
Strangers & Freaks is NOT part of the 100% checklist, so it is easy to leave until after the story. Do it in Stage 5 with the rest of the cleanup.
guide.tracking: The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows completed strands.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps: In Chapter 3, do the main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). During it you unlock the Key Cloner, and the Zorrusso delivery counts as the first car.
Randy then gives you a wish list of 16 sports cars. Track it under Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy's Wish List. He is marked with a green RK icon in the west of Vice City.
Steal the cars he wants — he marks some in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street. Scan a car with WAiNK (hold Up) to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage.

Deliver in good condition for more money. When you finish the ones he marked, he marks new locations. His list: Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D.
guide.summary: Finish Randy's wish list: deliver 16 sports cars to his garage. It opens in Chapter 3 with the Zorrusso theft (which also unlocks the Key Cloner). The best hunting ground is the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where the cars are parked outside hotels or driving around.
tips: Scan before you steal: WAiNK tells you instantly whether a car is on Randy's list, so you never waste a trip.
This can be done entirely after the story. The cars keep spawning, and Randy keeps marking new locations as you finish his picks.
guide.tracking: Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; the green RK icon marks Randy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps: Play as Jason in Chapter 3. After the main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, Tyrone's strand opens — Jason only.
Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter).
Destroy enough labs and Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs). Finish it and the trophy pops.
All of this is still available after the story.
guide.summary: Finish Tyrone's two-quest strand: destroy the Synthetic Labs, then shut them down for good. It opens in Chapter 3 for Jason only, after Here, Kitty Kitty, with purple lab markers across Vice City.
tips: Tyrone's strand does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — it is a separate questline trophy.
Bring explosives. Labs go down faster with sticky bombs than with gunfire, and you will be fighting their guards at the same time.
guide.tracking: Purple Synthetic Lab markers on the map, Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps: FIRST, in Chapter 1: the morning after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept. This meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway.
After Chapter 2's Coffee Break you can play both characters together. Meditate at each of the 10 outdoor spots with BOTH Jason and Lucia: each spot then counts twice, toward the 18 total.
The 10th spot, the stone circle on Mount Kalaga, only appears after you finish the others — do not search for it early.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18.
guide.summary: Meditate at every spot in Leonida — 18 meditations across 10 locations. Each outdoor spot counts twice if both characters meditate there, so bring your partner every time. This is the only trophy in the game that may be missable, and only because of the Chapter 1 balcony meditation.
tips: Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. The final spot (Mount Kalaga stone circle) appears only after the other nine are done.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops. If the balcony meditation turns out to be required, that save is your only way back.
guide.tracking: Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1. It is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, play as Jason. Bret Vogel texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. The strand is Jason-only.
Meet Bret. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 — retrieve it from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation.
Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. One clean shot leaves a kill in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required.

Track progress under Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) > Target Deck. There are 15 Target Decks and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so you will finish this strand naturally along the way.
guide.summary: Hunt for Bret Vogel. His strand opens after Coffee Break (Jason only) with a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Clear his hunting requests across the 15 Target Decks. Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still being confirmed — clearing all 15 decks, which 100% needs anyway, should cover it.
tips: Do not hunt the wrong animals: only Bret's marked requests count. The purple icons are the request list.
The Killtelligence SM-69 is yours to keep after the first quest. One clean shot pays more, so take your time and aim for the vitals.
guide.tracking: Map > Activities > Target Deck (15 decks total).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.unconfirmedNote: PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy. Clearing all 15 Target Decks should cover it.

steps: Find collectible cards across Leonida. There are 18 card sets in total; the trophy needs any 3 complete sets.
Cards are found in the open world — check the collectibles guide on the Sources page for the set locations.
For the 100% checklist you need 15 of 18 sets, so this trophy comes well before you finish the cards.
Complete 3 sets and the trophy pops. You do not need to finish all 18 for this one.
guide.summary: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; 100% needs 15 of the 18 sets, so this trophy arrives early on the way to A Long Road.
tips: Work on cards while you are doing other things in the same area — they are small pickups, not a separate grind.
If a set is missing one card, check the map's collectibles view: found cards stay marked, so the gap is easy to spot.
guide.tracking: Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

steps: Open the WAiNK phone app: hold Up, then hold R1 to scan. WAiNK scans are objects in the environment — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
There are far more than 100 scannable spots: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass.
Make it a habit: every time you arrive somewhere new, hold Up and scan the area before you drive on.
WAiNK is the same app you use to scan vehicles, so this trophy and Whip It Good progress together.
guide.summary: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, and there are well over 100 of them — so this is a habit trophy, not a hunt: scan as you travel and it fills itself in.
tips: Scan in towns, not on highways: landmarks and curiosities cluster where there are buildings and signs to look at.
If you are stuck under 100, check the map's WAiNK view — unscanned spots are listed by region.
guide.tracking: The WAiNK app shows your scan count; Progress > Collections > WAiNK Scans.

steps: Open Progress > Challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game; the trophy needs any 50.
Most challenges complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist. Do not chase them early.
When you are near the end, open the list and pick the easiest remaining ones — the list shows a Completed checkmark on each challenge you have done.
For the 100% checklist you need 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there.
guide.summary: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. There are 10 more than you need for the trophy, so skip the hardest ones and pick the easiest 50. Most of them finish on their own while you play.
tips: Leave this trophy for last. By the time you are cleaning up, you will already have most of the 50 without trying.
The challenge list is the tracker — scroll it and the checkmarks show exactly what is left.
guide.tracking: Progress > Challenges — a Completed checkmark shows on each finished challenge.

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps: First, unlock partner free-roam: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break you can roam with Jason and Lucia together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.
Get a 4-star wanted level — cause enough carnage and it comes quickly.
Escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to get out of the search area. If a helicopter is on you, shoot at it until it leaves.

The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone — not just the blue/red flashing search area. The easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there.
guide.summary: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. You need both characters together (after Coffee Break), a 4-star wanted level, and a clean escape out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy way out.
tips: You will probably get this automatically in Chapter 4: the large bank vault robberies always trigger 4-star wanted levels, and escaping them is the same move.
If the trophy does not pop, check you actually left the red heat zone — leaving the flashing search area alone is not enough.
guide.tracking: The wanted stars and the red heat zone on the minimap are the tracker.

trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps: First, unlock partner free-roam after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle.

Hit 3 robbery targets in a row (green icons on the map) while staying chased the whole time. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level — do not let it drop, and do not let it rise to the red heat level.
Gear up first: an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.
Loot 3 shops in a row. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — wait for it. If it does not unlock, hit a 4th shop and keep going.

A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City (open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). Rob a couple of items in each, go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before police arrive, you may need a 4th.
guide.summary: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping the wanted level alive the whole time. The trick is the middle ground: keep the flashing wanted level, never lose it, never let it become the red heat level. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City are the cleanest run.
tips: Rob a couple of items per store and crack the back-room safe — a rushed grab sometimes does not register as a robbery.
If the first store is quiet and the police have not arrived when you leave, the chain may not count. Hit a fourth store to be safe.
guide.tracking: Green robbery icons on the map; the wanted stars show your level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps: Open the WAiNK phone app (hold Up to use it instantly, without opening the phone). Look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive the vehicle.
Every new unique vehicle adds to the database. You need 100 discovered; the game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
For the 100% checklist you need 200 of the 277 base model vehicles, so this trophy comes on the way there. Scan boats and aircraft too.
guide.summary: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK. You do not need to drive them — a scan from the roadside counts. With 557 vehicles in the game, a busy road and ten minutes of scanning is most of the trophy.
tips: Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles — scrolling over each category shows how many you have found.
Scan early and often during the story. Vehicles you pass in missions count, and starting early means the trophy is done before you notice it.
guide.tracking: Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles — totals per category.

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps: Combat Focus activates with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm. It slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, draining the purple focus bar in the top left (below health and stamina).
Buff your focus first: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend the focus time (hold L1, then press Triangle).
Line up 5 enemies — gang members at Gang Operations are ideal — and take them down quickly without missing. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover and get close.
Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556: full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang members.
guide.summary: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). Focus lasts only a few seconds, so buff it first, line up five gang members at a Gang Operation, and drop them fast with an assault rifle.
tips: Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, the purple eye icon). Raise it with shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by the time you reach Focus level 4 this trophy gets much easier.
You will probably earn it naturally while working on the other trophies. If it has not popped by the endgame, do it at a Gang Operation with full focus and Adrenaline.
guide.tracking: Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus shows your focus level.

trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA). You need one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal — the planes parked on the airfield do not work.

The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. You can also walk in through the terminal.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed — keep flying until it unlocks.
guide.summary: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA departure terminal and fly it away. The plane has to be one connected to a boarding bridge — the E3/E4 terminal plane is the easiest. Get in, get airborne, and fly 1 km clear of the airport.
tips: Going over the airfield fence is faster than walking through the terminal, but both routes reach the same plane.
Do not land early: the trophy needs 1 km of distance from the airport, and the pop lags a little behind that.
guide.tracking: In-game — the trophy pops once you are 1 km clear of VCIA.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base.
Get in through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance if the gate is guarded.
Enter a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. Expect a heavy response — the base is defended.
guide.summary: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west of the map and shoot enemies with it. The tanks are parked in the south of the base; drive in through the gate or jump the south-east entrance.
tips: Bring body armor and be ready to fight your way in. The base defends itself, and the tank is slow to get moving.
Once you are in the tank, the trophy only needs you to shoot enemies with it — you do not need to escape the base.
guide.tracking: In-game — the trophy pops after shooting enemies from the tank.

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps: First finish Chapter 3's main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun (for silently lockpicking alarmed doors) and jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged map areas.

Go to a jewelry store and enter through the back door using the Snap Gun. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently — you do not need to equip it. Kicking the door triggers the alarm, so use the Snap Gun prompt instead.
Inside the back room, look for a note with the safe code, then use the code to loot the safe.
A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
guide.summary: Rob a jewelry store silently. Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun, then use it on a back door — never kick the door — find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe without being detected.
tips: If the alarm goes off, leave and try another store. The trophy needs a clean run, not a fast one.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the easiest layout to learn the route on.
guide.tracking: Green jewelry store icons on the map (unfogged areas).

trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). It is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch the guard carry a briefcase of cash inside, then go in while the vault is open and rob it.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone. Hold Right to hand off one bag.

After the introduction, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000). He marks the vans with a purple icon; follow them to the bank. (Do Yasmani's earlier quests first — robbing 2 Payday Loans — or he will not sell the tips.)
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level. Escape on a fast motorcycle to cut through traffic, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total. The trophy needs any 5, but the 100% checklist needs all 8 — so you will earn it automatically.
guide.summary: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The system opens in Chapter 4 with That's Where The Money Is…: tail a security van, slip in while the vault is open, take the cash with your partner, and outrun the 4-star wanted level. Each vault pays up to $205,000, making this the best money in the endgame.
tips: Yasmani's $10,000 tips are worth it — they mark the vans for you instead of leaving you to find them.
Hot Together comes free here: every vault robbery is a 4-star escape with your partner, so the two trophies share the same getaways.
guide.tracking: Scroll over a bank's map icon to see which vaults you have robbed.

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps: Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). Robbing the vault of a large bank automatically counts as robbing an armored truck — the trophy pops with the first bank job.
Or do it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks. Block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up.
Either way, the trophy only unlocks after you escape the red heat radius — use a Pay 'n' Spray or switch vehicles to drop the heat.
Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Yasmani becomes your fence automatically from Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
guide.summary: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission — the first vault counts as a truck robbery. Or stop a truck on the street near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the heat.
tips: You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist anyway, so this trophy is effectively free once the vaults open.
If you do the street method, plan the escape first: a Pay 'n' Spray on your route out saves the run.
guide.tracking: In-game — pops after escaping the red heat radius.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps: Open the map. Any area still covered in black fog is unexplored.
The fastest way to clear the fog is a plane: fly over every fogged area until the whole map is visible.
Work region by region so you do not miss a corner. The fog lifts as you fly over an area — you do not need to land in it.
Once the last patch clears, the trophy pops.
guide.summary: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. A plane is the fastest tool: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is entirely visible. You do not need to land anywhere — flying over is enough.
tips: Do this late, when you already have a plane from another trophy (Catch Me If You Can leaves you with one).
Unfogging also reveals activity icons, stunt spots and collectibles, so it makes every other trophy easier.
guide.tracking: The map itself — black fog is what is left to explore.

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps: Find Illegal Operations: they are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
There are 9 gangs and 39 operations in total. The trophy needs just 1 operation from each gang.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
For the 100% checklist you need all 39 operations, so this trophy comes on the way there.
guide.summary: Rob one Illegal Operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; the trophy only needs one per gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so keep going after this pops.
tips: Operations near your current location are the cheapest to do — check the yellow icons around you before travelling across the state.
If a gang's counter is stuck at zero, check Progress > Gangs: it tells you exactly which gang still needs one.
guide.tracking: Progress > Gangs — per-gang robbery counts.

trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view in front of you. The trophy pops as you drink.
guide.summary: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, order an Apple Martini, and drink it at the bar. This one was unconfirmed at launch and is now verified — it is that simple.
tips: No mission, no unlock and no prerequisite: the bar is open whenever you can reach Ocean Beach.
Do it while you are in the area for another trophy — Ocean Beach is also where Randy's sports cars are easiest to find.
guide.tracking: In-game — the trophy pops as you drink the martini.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps: First, unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. You cannot steal the car without it.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee on display.
Hack into the Banshee with the Key Cloner, get in, drive forward and straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed — keep driving down the street and it unlocks. Only the blue Banshee works; no other car triggers it.
guide.summary: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it through the window. You need the Key Cloner from Chapter 3, and it has to be that specific blue Banshee — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
tips: Drive straight at the window and do not brake. A hesitant run can leave you stuck in the showroom with the alarm going.
This is a verified method now: it was unconfirmed at launch and PowerPyx has since confirmed the exact car and showroom.
guide.tracking: In-game — the trophy pops shortly after you drive out through the window.

trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps: Buy Sticky Bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to destroy the safe.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the Gang Operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

Inside, take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow it up with Sticky Bombs.
Escape the police. The trophy unlocks after you escape, not when you pick up the third item. Killing the enemies is not necessary.
guide.summary: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and the safe (sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police — not when you grab the last item.
tips: Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for just the remaining valuables.
You do not need all 3 in one visit. Two now and the safe later still unlocks the trophy.
guide.tracking: Golden icons mark the valuables inside the bowling alley.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

steps: First, unlock switching between both characters after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

Work out to raise Strength. Buy a membership at a fitness club and train — filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon). There are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
Always go together: hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner. While you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double progress.
Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character) > Strength (heart icon). When both characters are at maximum strength at the same time, the trophy pops.
guide.summary: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs together — while one trains, the other trains automatically, so always bring your partner.
tips: This is the only trophy that needs both characters maxed at once. Do not max one and then switch: train them together from the start.
Gym sessions also raise Focus and count toward activities, so the time is not wasted.
guide.tracking: Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon) per character.

steps: Do 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts.

Turn on the notifications so you can see it working: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On. A little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action changes your reputation.

Profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened (incapacitating enemies, limb shots), Violent (killing enemies and civilians) and Psycho (killing many cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) to Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid excessive violence if you do not want the cops permanently more aggressive.
You can track the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. It will mostly happen passively; if it has not popped by the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
guide.summary: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Robberies, fights and escapes all count, and the total builds passively across the whole game. Turn the profile notifications on so you can watch the demon-face icon appear as you play.
tips: Do not chase Irredeemable on purpose: it is permanent and makes the police shoot on sight more often, which makes the cleanup harder.
If you are short at the end, a car is the fastest farm — but keep a save from before you start, in case the profile heat gets in the way.
guide.tracking: Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500.

steps: The method for this trophy is not yet confirmed by any guide. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.
Do the Payday Loans content when it appears and keep an eye on the Sources page — this guide updates the method the moment the community confirms it.
Do not grind anything for this trophy until a method is confirmed. A wrong guess costs hours; a confirmed method costs minutes.
guide.summary: Method unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes this trophy is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. This guide lists it as unconfirmed rather than guessing.
tips: Check back on the Sources page: the unconfirmed list is updated as the community verifies each trigger.
Payday Loans also matters for Dime on the Dollar (marked bills) and Yasmani's tips, so you will be there anyway.
guide.tracking: Unknown — no in-game counter is known yet.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.unconfirmedNote: PowerPyx: currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue.

steps: Go alone — no partner — to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed. At the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car. If it is not there, drive away and come back.
When the blinking car is there, follow the path from it into the woods. You will see the UFO — a bright blue light in the sky.
Approach the UFO. It drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help. She asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and the trophy unlocks.
guide.summary: Complete the UFO easter egg. After 2AM, alone, on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County: find the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, meet the abducted woman it drops, and walk her back to her car. This was unconfirmed at launch and is now verified.
tips: The blinking car is the trigger — no car, no UFO. If the road is empty, leave the area and return; the spawn re-rolls.
Go solo. The event is written for a lone character, and bringing your partner can break the spawn.
guide.tracking: In-game — the UFO event itself is the tracker.

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps: The method for this trophy is not yet confirmed by any guide. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle.
Try it while you are riding: a melee kick from a moving motorcycle at an enemy is the current best belief — but treat it as a belief, not a method.
Check the Sources page for the confirmed method the moment the community verifies it.
guide.summary: Method unconfirmed. The hint is a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects kicking an enemy while riding a motorcycle. No guide has confirmed it yet, so this guide does not present a guess as a method.
tips: Do not grind this one blind. A melee drive-by is easy to attempt while doing other things on a bike — try it in passing, not as a session.
The name is a bowling pun (Ten Pin), but the trigger is a vehicle melee attack, not a bowling alley.
guide.tracking: Unknown — no in-game counter is known yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.unconfirmedNote: PowerPyx: currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps: First finish Chapter 3's main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew). It unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans. The marked bills go to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
You need $250,000 in marked bills delivered in total. It counts across all robberies; you do not need to bring $250,000 at once.
Bank vaults are the fastest source: up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes — but vaults only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
guide.summary: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Unlock the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3 (Credit Check), rob banks and Payday Loans, and fence the bills with Yasmani. The total accumulates across robberies, and one bank vault can be worth up to $205,000 on its own.
tips: This comes naturally from the robbery trophies: every vault and Payday Loan you rob for other trophies feeds this total.
Yasmani pays the most, so take the bills to him even if another fence is closer.
guide.tracking: Your fence totals — the $250,000 accumulates across all deliveries.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types. Every shop counts — guns, car mods, tattoos, clothes, hair, electronics.

The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods at mod shops, and tattoos. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 11 tattoo studios, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 15 electronics stores and 19 Pay 'n' Sprays.
Buy what you actually want first — weapons, armor and car upgrades are all useful for other trophies — and the total will climb on its own.
If you are short at the end, buy the most expensive single items you have not bought yet rather than many cheap ones.
guide.summary: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route — they are the most expensive things in the game — and the total counts across every shop type.
tips: Do not save this for last on purpose: the guns and mods you buy for other trophies (Gunslinger, the races, the robberies) all count here.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so money is never the blocker — spend it as you earn it.
guide.tracking: No single in-game counter — the total is the sum of your spending.

steps: Play Chapter 2 until the main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses). After it you get a notification: a new app, Vice City Real Estate, is installed on your phone.
Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the phone app. They cost $160,000 in total. The 4 story-related garages do not count — only the 8 purchasable ones.
A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially in Chapters 3–4 when the higher-value robberies open.
Buy all 8 and the trophy pops. Garages also add parking spots, which you need for On the Spot.
guide.summary: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app ($160,000 total). The app arrives after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. The 4 story garages do not count.
tips: Pair this with On the Spot: each garage adds parking spots, and you need the space to register 10 vehicles.
Robberies are the fastest money. By Chapter 4 the bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each — one vault covers a garage.
guide.tracking: Vice City Real Estate app — it lists the garages you own.

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps: Play Chapter 2 until the main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). After it the Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone — it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere.
Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes). Each garage adds parking spots, and you need the space to register 10 vehicles.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn. In his garage click Respray and then Register. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers. Later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, and register them at any Pay 'n' Spray.
guide.summary: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Moses mission in Chapter 2. Buy garages first for the parking space, then bring cheap stolen cars and bikes to Moses in Port Gellhorn and register them.
tips: Cheap cars and bikes keep the registration fees low — do not register sports cars here, save those for Randy.
If a car has a tracker Moses will not take it early on. Stick to tracker-free cars until Chapter 3, then use Pay 'n' Sprays for the rest.
guide.tracking: Scooter Bros app — it shows your registered vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
